One seed27;30/60/90minutes; empty,partial,fully supporteddeclared measured tested grid. One native process per ride, paired identical earned starting fixtures. Includes12s sensor outage and60s actual cadence-zero rider pause outside probes. Training and testing use separate declared seeds; no physical hardware or flash-persistence validation. Whole-ride scores include the pedaling pause; requested power is unattainable at zero cadence. Display dates describe the batch execution. Original longride.json and unchanged full-rate case files are archived. Fully learned means the declared measured tested grid only; RAM fixture import does not test flash persistence.
